text:
deploybot: deploycheck failed for release inference-service v2.10.0 -> production. blocking reason: secret 'storage/processing' schema mismatch between staging and prod (staging: string JSON, prod: legacy map/object). preflight error: schema-check mismatch. rollout paused.

morgan: which service/shard is affected? canary showed some cache errors earlier.

ben: inference-runtime on inference-service (prod). canary was bumped to v2.10.0, prod still on v2.9.1 but deploy attempt happened and deploycheck flagged secret parity.

raj: that secret is read during model load to build KVCACHE keys. if prod has map encoded vs staging string, the runtime fails to parse and emits 400 on prefix lookup. explains canary weirdness.

ana: i can convert the prod secret to the new stringified schema but this touches KMS unwrap path. need a planned change window and a short rollout. who owns the backfill? @ana volunteering to run with a small migration script.

tara: i'm oncall. prefer not to mutate secrets during high traffic hours. suggestion: rollback prod to the pinned image (v2.9.1) immediately to reduce blast radius, then do backfill in midnight change window.

morgan: alternative quick mitigation: add shim in runtime to accept both encodings for ~24h (PR ready). less risky than live secret migration. PR #4521 is tiny adapter layer.

ben: PR looks fine but there is also a KMS alias mismatch — prod uses alias/old-kms while staging uses alias/new-kms. adapter alone won't fix unwrap failure if key alias differs. need secret re-encryption or key alias mapping.

ops-bot: note: rollout hold set by deploybot. Change request required for secret re-encrypt/rewrite.

morgan: decision call: rollback prod deploy to v2.9.1 now, create a changelist for midnight window to run backfill + re-encrypt with correct alias, merge runtime shim as a fastfail safety net. Ben to perform rollback, Ana to assemble migration script and runbook, I'll update release notes.

ben: rolling back now. running: ```kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference inference=image.registry/redwood/inference:v2.9.1 && kubectl rollout status deployment/inference -n prod```

ops-bot: deployment inference scaled down to previous replica set; rollout succeeded. notif: prod traffic back on v2.9.1.

ana: I'll prepare backfill steps and post the runbook here before midnight. includes: 1) re-encrypt secret with alias/new-kms, 2) write canonical stringified value, 3) verify canary reads, 4) promote.

tara: add a release note bullet: "Hotfix: rollback due to secret schema parity mismatch; migration scheduled for change window; customers on Dedicated/Private should verify KMS alias mapping."

morgan: added to release notes and changelog draft. we'll also add an internal postmortem once migration completes.

ben: thumbs up, closing this thread once migration done.

deploybot: release hold remains until manual release-unblock command is given.
